title: Patch where the text is new: a compression view of where byte-level models should spend compute
abstract: arXiv:2610.22100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) run their large global model once per patch and start a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high. This rule rarely starts a patch at in-line computed results, such as the number after "=" in a worked solution, and accuracy on them collapses under tight patch budgets. We propose novelty patching, motivated by LZ77-style compression: start a patch where the upcoming bytes are unlikely to repeat the recent context. The rule is a lookup table over the previous two bytes, fitted in seconds on raw text with no labels, reference model or losses. In BLT-style models trained from scratch on a 1.9 GB math corpus at a matched ~11% patch rate (3 seeds each), it has no clear effect at 1M parameters, raises final-answer accuracy from 47% to 72% at 12M, and at 50M raises computed-result accuracy from 21% to 57% and final-answer accuracy from 60% to 90%; a table fitted on

translated_title: 在文本新颖处切分补丁：字节级模型应将算力投入何处的压缩视角
translated_abstract: 诸如字节潜在Transformer（BLT）等字节级语言模型在每个补丁上运行一次大型全局模型，并在小模型的下一字节熵较高处开始新补丁。然而这一规则很少在行内计算结果处开始新补丁，例如解题过程中"="后面的数字，在紧凑的补丁预算下这些位置的准确率会大幅下降。受LZ77式压缩的启发，我们提出新颖性打补丁：在即将到来的字节不太可能重复近期上下文的位置开始新补丁。该规则是一个基于前两个字节的查找表，仅需在原始文本上几秒钟即可拟合完成，无需标注数据、参考模型或损失函数。在1.9 GB数学语料库上从头训练的BLT风格模型中，在匹配的约11%补丁率下（每种设置各3个随机种子），该方法在1M参数量下没有明显效果，在12M参数量下将最终答案准确率从47%提升至72%，在50M参数量下将计算结果准确率从21%提升至57%、最终答案准确率从60%提升至90%；在……上拟合的表
tldr: 提出受LZ77压缩启发的新颖性打补丁方法——用一个几秒钟即可在无标注文本上拟合的、基于前两个字节的查找表，在字节不重复近期上下文处切分补丁，从而大幅提升字节级语言模型在数学任务上的准确率（50M参数下最终答案准确率从60%升至90%）。
en_tdlr: Proposes novelty patching, an LZ77-compression-inspired rule that uses a lookup table over the previous two bytes—fitted in seconds on raw text with no labels—to start patches where upcoming bytes are unlikely to repeat recent context, substantially improving byte-level language model accuracy on math (e.g., final-answer accuracy from 60% to 90% at 50M parameters).
